meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-18 — extraction is clean (this book is in English). Same source and treatment as iqra_curriculum_g1_english_sem1.json: unit titles, page numbers, vocabulary, grammar phrases, and listening skill descriptors taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5); the Speaking/Reading/Writing/Project/Viewing columns on page 5 were not used. Each numbered unit is split into two lessons — Vocabulary & Grammar, and Listening & Speaking.
known_gaps: This is real content (vocabulary lists, grammar phrases, listening skill descriptors), not title-only — but it is unit-level, not lesson-level: each unit's actual internal lesson count and exact per-page lesson titles were not verified page by page.

Following the g4/g5 English precedent, `main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display.

Phonics letter/word-family lists printed inside the table's Vocabulary column are excluded from `vocabulary` — they are letter-sound drill items, not thematic vocabulary, and this schema has no separate field for them.

The book's own 'Welcome: Who's this?' section is unnumbered in the table of contents (units are numbered 5-8, continuing Semester 1's own numbering, starting at 'My body') — modeled here as an unnumbered unit (`number: 0`), same technique as Semester 1's own Welcome unit. Unlike Semester 1's Welcome unit, this one DOES carry a full Grammar and Listening entry in the scope-and-sequence table, so it uses the same two-lesson shape as every numbered unit — a genuine content difference between the two semesters' Welcome sections, not an inconsistency in extraction.
